Constructs and executes HTTP fetch requests for SUSE OVAL security data files from the official SUSE FTP server.

## Key Components

- **`newFetchRequests(suseType string, target []string) []util.FetchRequest`** — Builds a slice of `FetchRequest` structs targeting gzipped OVAL XML files at `https://ftp.suse.com/pub/projects/security/oval/`, formatted as `<suseType>.<version>.xml.gz`.
- **`FetchFiles(suseType string, versions []string) ([]util.FetchResult, error)`** — Public entry point that generates fetch requests for the given SUSE type and version list, then delegates to `util.FetchFeedFiles` to retrieve the files. Returns an error if no versions are provided or if fetching fails.

## Usage Example

```go
package main

import (
    "fmt"
    "github.com/vulsio/goval-dictionary/fetcher/suse"
)

func main() {
    // Fetch OVAL data for OpenSUSE Leap versions
    results, err := suse.FetchFiles("opensuse.leap", []string{"42.2", "42.3"})
    if err != nil {
        panic(err)
    }

    // Fetch OVAL data for SUSE Linux Enterprise Server
    results, err = suse.FetchFiles("suse.linux.enterprise.server", []string{"12", "15"})
    if err != nil {
        panic(err)
    }

    fmt.Printf("Fetched %d OVAL files\n", len(results))
}
```

Supported `suseType` values follow the naming convention used on the SUSE FTP server (e.g., `opensuse.leap`, `opensuse`, `suse.linux.enterprise.desktop`, `suse.linux.enterprise.server`).
